{{Quote|Master Windu! Master Windu!''"<br />"''Veda! Get back here immediately!''"<br />"''But I want to ask him something!"|Veda and her instructor|<ref name="BFP" />}}
'''Veda''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] studying within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At a young age, Veda was identified and inducted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and began her [[Jedi training/Legends|studies]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="BFP" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Veda and her [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|clan]] were passing down a corridor at the temple, when she recognized [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] passing by and went to him to ask the senior [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] a "very important question," much to the distress of [[Unidentified Jedi instructor|her instructor]].<ref name="BFP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Veda appeared in the [[2004]] young readers novel ''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]'', written by [[Elizabeth Hand]].<ref name="BFP" />
